snippet.title: Andy Weir, Phil Lord & Christopher Miller React to First Look at Project Hail Mary MR Experience
snippet.description:
Watch Andy Weir, alongside filmmakers Phil Lord and Christopher Miller, as they experience an early look at the Project Hail Mary mixed reality game.

Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars is a mixed-reality experience expanding Andy Weir’s bestselling sci-fi universe into immersive interactive entertainment, placing players inside an untold chapter of the Hail Mary mission.
